question: What is the overall Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) score for India for the year 2023-24 as reported by NITI Aayog?
solution:
The correct answer is __**71**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India's overall Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) score for the year 2023-24 is **71** as reported by NITI Aayog.
 
• The SDG score reflects India's performance in achieving the 17 Sustainable Development Goals set by the United Nations.
 
• NITI Aayog, the policy think tank of the Government of India, is responsible for monitoring and reporting on the progress of SDGs in the country.
 
• The score is an aggregate of various metrics, including poverty, hunger, health, education, gender equality, clean water and sanitation, affordable and clean energy, and more.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):**

 
 
• SDGs are a collection of 17 global goals set by the United Nations General Assembly in 2015.
 
• The goals are part of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, which aims to address global challenges including poverty, inequality, climate change, environmental degradation, peace, and justice.
 
• The SDGs are interconnected and are designed to achieve a better and more sustainable future for all.
 
 
 
• **NITI Aayog:**
 
 
• NITI Aayog stands for National Institution for Transforming India.
 
• It was established in 2015, replacing the Planning Commission.
 
• NITI Aayog's primary role is to foster cooperative federalism through structured support initiatives and mechanisms with the States on a continuous basis.
 
• It also provides relevant strategic and technical advice to the central and state governments.
 
 
 
• **SDG India Index:**
 
 
• The SDG India Index is a tool developed by NITI Aayog to monitor and report the progress of SDGs at the national and state levels.
 
• The index ranks states and union territories based on their performance in achieving the SDGs.
 
• It includes a comprehensive set of indicators covering all 17 goals.
 
 
 
• **UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network (SDSN):**
 
 
• The SDSN was launched in 2012 to mobilize global scientific and technological expertise to promote practical solutions for sustainable development.
 
• It works closely with UN agencies, multilateral financing institutions, the private sector, and civil society.
 
• The SDSN supports the implementation of the SDGs and the Paris Climate Agreement.
